summary: Prudential PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting resolutions passed at its Annual General Meeting on May 28, 2026. The resolutions authorize political donations up to £50,000 and renew directors' authority to allot ordinary shares under the Companies Act 2006, with specific nominal caps. No price, premium, structural mechanics, or regulatory clock are involved. This is a routine AGM filing containing standard governance authorities, not a special situation event.
